entry.title: New: RES24-069 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF SHIPPING SERVICES VALUED AT $2,500 TO THE CITY FROM ALOHA AIR CARGO FOR SHIPPING FLOWERS AND LEI FROM THE NEIGHBOR ISLANDS TO SUPPORT THE MAKING AND COLLECTION OF 38,000 LEI TO ADORN THE GRAVES OF OUR SERVICE MEMBERS BURIED AT THE NATIONAL CEMETERY OF THE PACIFIC AT PUOWAINA AS PART OF THE MAYOR’S MEMORIAL DAY CEREMONY.

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution were adopted.
